groups.activity: log in until a weapon milestone, then pick it

rows.label: Sigma & Octantis (login pick)
rows.note: one of four weapon choices from Day 300 onward; reappears every 200 days if you pick something else

conditions: Weapon milestones only start at Day 300; the Day 100 milestone offers Azima, Zenistar and Zenith only.
Daily Tribute counts total login days, not a consecutive streak, so missing a day only costs that day.
bonuses: Arrives fully built with its own weapon slot and a pre-installed Orokin Catalyst.

disclosures.title: the Simaris blueprint is a rebuy only
disclosures.body: Cephalon Simaris sells the blueprint for 100,000 Standing (30,000 credits, 4 Morphics, 450 Circuits, 500 Polymer Bundle, 2,750 Salvage, 1 day to build), but it appears in his Offerings only after you have picked the weapon via Daily Tribute, so it only gets you a second copy.
